description: Firewall device list GETs the firewall's devices collection. Both languages reject a non-positive firewall_id with the same text; the missing-id message diverges (see report).

cases.name: rejects a non-positive firewall_id
cases.expect_error: firewall_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: rejects a page_size below the minimum

cases.name: rejects a page_size above the maximum
cases.expect_error: page_size must be an integer from 25 through 500
